quest.title: Farewell to the Past
quest.description: Many people's memories have escaped from the damaged roots of the Sacred Sakura. Raiden Ei takes the opportunity to tell you many stories about her cherished friends and the Inazuma she wants to protect.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x600, Mora x44000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x10

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Once again, please leave them to me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, hey! A—Are you sure you're alright? You're scaring us!

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Fear not. Fighting is what I do best.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ei, maybe you should leave this one to us.

choices.text: You don't look too good.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: My apologies.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry about it! Just take a breather and get your strength back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll deal with the monsters!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look... that's the same light again.

choices.text: Time for another trip down memory lane.

response.speaker: Fujiki
response.text: Wh—Where am I?

response.speaker: Fujiki
response.text: Who are you... *gasp* Almighty Shogun, you're here too!

response.speaker: Fujiki
response.text: Are you injured, Your Excellency?

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Ahem... I'm quite alright. Just feeling a little stiff.

response.speaker: Fujiki
response.text: We, the Shogunate samurai, will defend the Shogun until the very end!

response.speaker: Fukami
response.text: Come on, men! They're coming back for more, let's get them!

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Don't. It's too dangerous.

response.speaker: Fujiki
response.text: Danger is our duty, Ma'am! If we were the kind to shy away from danger, we never would've taken up arms to begin with.

response.speaker: Fukami
response.text: No need to worry, Almighty Shogun. When the situation looks bleak, we will draw on the power granted to us by the gods.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is that a Vision?

response.speaker: Fujiki
response.text: It certainly is. I know the gods are omnipotent, and their willingness to grant their power to humans means that they have high expectations for us.

response.speaker: Fujiki
response.text: If the Almighty Shogun is in trouble, now of all times is the moment for us to honor that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that's how samurai of that era understood Visions, huh...

choices.text: So full of hope.

response.speaker: Fukami
response.text: Nobody knew where Your Excellency had gone, and we were starting to despair. But now we've found you. You are right here with us.

response.speaker: Fukami
response.text: Just the sight of you appearing before us once more has reignited the hope in our hearts.

response.speaker: Fukami
response.text: This hope is the light that will guide us out from the darkness.

response.speaker: Fujiki
response.text: Everyone, on me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll help too!

response.speaker: Fujiki
response.text: Huh...?

response.speaker: Fujiki
response.text: Affirmative. But watch your backs!

choices.text: An unwavering commitment to resistance.
Who have we got this time...
Don't force it.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiki
dialogues.text: It seems like their attacks are finally over.

dialogues.speaker: Fukami
dialogues.text: Huh, I've never fought so fiercely before!

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Thank you all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Umm... Are you okay? Maybe you should keep resting...

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I'm fine. I feel much better already.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiki
dialogues.text: You fought phenomenally. It was truly awe-inspiring.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiki
dialogues.text: The monsters will definitely come back. And when they do, it'll be more than a few rifthounds this time.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiki
dialogues.text: Quickly, escort Her Excellency back to Inazuma City, and regroup with the general's forces as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Fukami
dialogues.text: When everyone sees the Almighty Shogun safely returning, their spirits will be lifted.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well... what're you guys gonna do?

dialogues.speaker: Fujiki
dialogues.text: We will stay here and guard against the monsters' advance. We cannot afford to let them get any further.

dialogues.speaker: Fujiki
dialogues.text: We are brothers in arms. As long as we stick together, we can face any number of monsters that come our way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *gulp*...

choices.text: (We have no business disrupting the reality they are experiencing.)

response.speaker: Fukami
response.text: Just leave it to us! Fighting is what we do best!

response.speaker: Fukami
response.text: But the Almighty Shogun is the only one of us with the power to change the present state of affairs. Only Her Excellency can turn back the tide of despair and lead us onward into the future.

response.speaker: Fukami
response.text: No matter what kind of threat faces Inazuma, we will always place our faith in the Almighty Shogun!

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Thank you all very much. I promise you that I will create a bright future for Inazuma.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I should not have left it this late to make this promise. But from this moment forth, know that I shall be true to my word.

response.speaker: Fukami
response.text: Don't worry, Your Excellency. We will never doubt your word as long as we live!

response.speaker: Fukami
response.text: With you leading us, we will claim back everything that Inazuma has lost!

response.speaker: Fujiki
response.text: Glory to the Shogun!

response.speaker: Samurai
response.text: Glory to the Shogun!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...They're gone.

choices.text: Was that a promise to them...?

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: It was both.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: The people's sacrifice has always caused me immense pain, but in dwelling on the tragedy, I overlooked their splendor... The grief blinded me to how brightly they shone in their final moments.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: The result being that in the centuries since their sacrifice, I have dishonored their will.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: You could take the view that whatever I say to them is meaningless, because they are but disembodied memories held in the Ley Lines.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: But even so, they are due a resolution... I owe it to them and to all the people who have placed their faith in me to date.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... Paimon thinks that even if it's a few hundred years later, you're doing right by them now. And that's what counts.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Thank you for your comforting words. But this is my basic duty as Inazuma's archon, and I have neglected it for far too long.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I used to think just like that samurai... that I was first and foremost a warrior, and my only duty was to face whatever challenge came my way.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: But what Inazuma needs more than a warrior is someone like Makoto.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Even though I am utterly unlike Makoto, and can never become the person she was, I still need to do the things that she would have done.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Humans are worthy of your trust.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Yes, they are. They are strong and resilient, and have much to be proud of.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: As the Raiden Shogun they revere, I should not be the one to hold them back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well said! Sounds to Paimon like you've figured things out.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Change will come to Inazuma, and with it, new possibilities. This will take time, but eventually, the future will bring healing to the scars of the past.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: No matter how long it takes, I am committed to bringing this to fruition. This is my promise.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Now that we've dealt with the rifthounds, this matter is halfway resolved. It does not appear that the threat will escalate for the time being.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I will leave the Tenryou and Yashiro Commissions to handle the follow-up work, such as investigating the origins of this incident and tending to the root system.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alrighty then! Let's move on.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ei looks calm on the outside, but Paimon bets her emotions must be all over the place right now, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She seems to have changed a lot since we last met her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Hmm?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's wrong, Ei? C'mon, keep up.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Ugh...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ei!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's going on? Are you feeling unwell again?

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: My body... I can't move it.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: It looks like the situation is more serious than I thought.

choices.text: Do you need to take a rest?

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: No need. "She" is calling me. The time has come.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: #Can you help me walk, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I need to go to the cave below the Grand Narukami Shrine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why? What's in there?

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: A battleground... One where I shall sever ties with the past and take the first steps into the future.

choices.text: We should get you back to the city.
Or a promise to yourself?
Great, thanks. I appreciate it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... Paimon's dizzy, where did we get sucked into this time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! This place...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It does look a lot like the Plane of Euthymia.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! Look, over there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's another Ei!

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: We meet again, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: This body is an assistant to the one within. But it is also the guardian of the rules.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: Should the one within wish to stray from the rules, this body shall stand in her way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, Paimon knows that voice... is that... the puppet!?

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: You have wandered the realm in my body, and you appear to have grasped the true essence of eternity.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: You believe your present self has greater certainty than your former self. Thus, you believe your present self is correct. Don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: But have you really been enlightened with new ideas? Or have you been degraded by irreversible erosion?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I'm here to show you my answer.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: We are both warriors, and the dialogue we must now have shall be conducted by the blade alone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhhh, wait, wait, wait, the atmosphere in here just took a turn for the worse!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A—Are you, uh, are you alright now?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: The discomfort I was experiencing earlier was caused by the Shogun rejecting my continued use of her body.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: As she indicates, once I started entertaining the idea of change, I became hostile in her eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: But inside a realm of consciousness, I exist independently of her. She cannot affect me in this way.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Though she is a puppet, the Shogun has her own consciousness, too. When necessary, she appears here to confront me.

choices.text: I think you've mentioned this before...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Paimon gets that everyone has their internal battles and stuff, but... not like this! It's a bit extreme!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ei's showdown with the Shogun... Never thought we'd see that day.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: The rules I set for the Shogun are... no, the Shogun herself is the manifestation of my past ideals, the very foundation stone of eternity. It shall not be easily swayed.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I would not try to change her if it wasn't necessary.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Isn't there any other way? Can't you... talk it through? ...Or something?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ei isn't someone who leaves herself an escape route.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But they both just want the best for Inazuma...

response.speaker: Raiden Shogun
response.text: My form is a symbol of supreme majesty, in which has been vested power over all the realm. It is the cohesive embodiment of all that constitutes the "Raiden Shogun."

response.speaker: Raiden Shogun
response.text: It inherits Ei's pain — the pain of inevitable loss that comes as she moves forward. So too does it inherit her determination to reach eternity.

response.speaker: Raiden Shogun
response.text: Every action undertaken is for the sake of resisting erosion.

response.speaker: Raiden Shogun
response.text: Determination, courage, love, hatred... All of these will be degraded and distorted by the incessant flow of time.

response.speaker: Raiden Shogun
response.text: Only rules shall remain constant for eternity.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Those were my thoughts when I created you.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Now they are towering obstacles that I have no choice but to overcome.

response.speaker: Raiden Shogun
response.text: You wish to make yourself my enemy?

response.speaker: Raiden Shogun
response.text: I am your past, the everlasting law, the guardian of eternity.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: And I am she who promised a dream to her subjects... Raiden Ei.

choices.text: This is her system to safeguard against modifications to eternity?

talks.objective: Talk to Ei and ascertain her condition
Aid the samurai in defeating the Rifthounds

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like we got kicked out...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do we do? Are we really just gonna leave Ei and the Shogun to keep on duking it out in there forever!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She was making sense, and maybe this is the only way to change the Shogun's rules, but still...

choices.text: Ei has no physical body anymore, and has to rely on the Shogun.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right? Also, Ei can be pretty stubborn at times, and has a history of rushing into difficult situations...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What if she gets too obsessed with winning, and she forgets why she's there in the first place? It could happen... And then she might never leave again!

choices.text: We're not about to leave her just yet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We should help her out, like we did last time. The quicker she gets through this, the better.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is there any way we can cut down how long she needs to spend in there? Or, y'know, help her win the fight?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Umm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, whatever, we can't let anything bad happen to Ei while she's in there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Oh, but we also can't get in there anymore.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, well first things first, we gotta find a way back in! C'mon brain juice, don't fail Paimon now! Um, okay, maybe if we both ram into it at the same time, really really hard—

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We need to talk to Yae Miko.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you're right! Paimon nearly forgot about her!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who knows if she really understands these consciousness realm-plane thingies more than we do... But there's no one else we can turn to. Alright, up the mountain we go!

choices.text: Our work here isn't done.
But this cannot be the only way...

talks.objective: Talk to Ei and the samurai
Go to the cave below the Grand Narukami Shrine
Go to the cave below the Grand Narukami Shrine

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: We're finally here. The entrance should be nearby...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, where'd that torii gate come from?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: It's getting worse again... But it's fine, I'm about to put an end to it all.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: This is a place I once sealed off with my own hands... The entrance to Raiden Makoto's realm of consciousness.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: It looks like "she" will no longer allow me to do with this body as I please.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What are you talking about? And who is "she" — Makoto?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Follow me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where are we g— aah, aaah aaaah!!!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have you finally defeated her?

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: It appears your martial prowess has not dulled.

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: But how long can your will remain strong?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How the heck...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Surely the Shogun puppet isn't invincible...?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: In this realm of consciousness, her existence is tenacious indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: She was built to resist erosion. Her will is stronger than any other living being's, including you and me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then... does that mean this is gonna be a never-ending battle?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Maybe. But I have to prove to her that my present will is no product of erosion. The future I shall forge will be a grand undertaking, one that will be resistant to erosion.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: If I don't do this, the Shogun's rules can never change, and Inazuma can never move forward.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: This is my duty. No matter how long this battle may last, months, years, centuries... And no matter how many times we must fight, I will defeat her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What will happen to Inazuma in the meantime?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Five hundred years ago, humanity proved their strength in battle.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Here in the present, they rely on their ambition to challenge wayward practices, tear them out like the diseased wood of an old sakura tree, so that new, healthy branches might spring to life in their place.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: It is about time that I learned to trust them.

choices.text: But can you bear to leave humanity to go alone?

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I understand that. But if the dreams of which Makoto spoke are true eternity, a short moment for which the Shogun does not exist is nothing to fear.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I fight for the everlasting future of Inazuma. However long the battle may last, it is but a drop in the ocean of eternity.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I vow to the subjects of Inazuma that I shall one day return. This is my oath. Please be my witness.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: During my absence, I place everything in Miko's hands.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But, but this means that—

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Pass on my words.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ei!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa!

choices.text: Everyone looks to the Shogun for hope.

talks.objective: Talk to Paimon about how to respond

dialogues.speaker: Observe Teacup
dialogues.text: (A cup of tea has been left for Furuyama.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe Teacup
dialogues.text: (How much did he actually perceive, and how much did he let on?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should go. Let's keep following the traces.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Very well. Based on my investigation so far, I believe this next pack of monsters should be the last.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I'm fine, I...

dialogues.speaker: Fukami
dialogues.text: Protect the Almighty Shogun!

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: In the end, even the proud and mighty oni maiden was cut down and disgraced...

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: Though your blade has been cleansed of her blood and filth, never shall it shine as brightly as it once did.
